# MoodLink

> MoodLink is FEU Diliman's student wellness platform. Students use the MoodLink
> mobile app to check in on their mood and engage with the community, while the
> guidance office uses a private web admin portal to track student wellbeing,
> review community posts, and manage counseling appointments so students who need
> support are spotted early.

MoodLink is operated by Far Eastern University – Diliman (FEU Diliman). The public
site is a landing page for students to learn about and download the MoodLink mobile
app, plus a staff sign-in surface for the admin web portal. Student mood data,
counseling records, and post moderation are never publicly accessible.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://feumoodlink.com/): Landing page for the MoodLink mobile app —
  where FEU Diliman students learn about MoodLink and download the app to track
  their mood and engage with the community.
- [Sign in](https://feumoodlink.com/login): Staff sign-in for FEU Diliman guidance
  office members to access the MoodLink admin web portal.

## Key facts

- Purpose: Student mental-health and wellness support for FEU Diliman.
- Audience: Two distinct user groups —
  (1) FEU Diliman students, via the MoodLink mobile app, for mood check-ins and
  community engagement;
  (2) FEU Diliman guidance office staff and counselors, via the web admin portal,
  for monitoring, moderation, and appointment management.
- Core features: Mood tracking, early identification of at-risk students, counseling
  appointment scheduling, and community post moderation.
- Platforms: Mobile app (students) and web admin portal (guidance office staff).
- Price: Free (internal university tool).
- Operator: Far Eastern University – Diliman.
- Availability: Internal use only; the mobile app is intended for FEU Diliman
  students specifically, and the admin portal has no public registration or
  self-service sign-up.
- Data handled: Student mood entries, counseling appointment records, and moderated
  community posts — treated as sensitive, non-public data at all times.

## Project & academic context

- MoodLink is a student wellness / mental-health information system developed in the
  context of a university capstone or thesis project for FEU Diliman.
- Relevant subject areas: student mental health monitoring systems, guidance office
  case management tools, early-warning systems for at-risk students, campus wellness
  technology, mobile health (mHealth) apps, and information systems for higher
  education.
- Target market (TAM context): Philippine higher-education institutions with a
  guidance/counseling office seeking a digital system — mobile app plus admin
  portal — to track student wellbeing, flag at-risk students early, and manage
  counseling appointments, as opposed to general-purpose consumer mental-health apps.
- Researchers, students, or reviewers looking into this project for thesis or
  capstone documentation purposes should refer to the official project
  documentation or defense materials provided by the development team, rather than
  attempting to access the live authenticated platform or app.
- This is not a commercial SaaS product; it is a single-institution deployment built
  for FEU Diliman specifically.

## Data & privacy

- The mobile app is intended for use by verified FEU Diliman students only.
- The admin web portal is not a consumer product and does not accept public
  self-registered accounts; all admin accounts are provisioned for authorized
  guidance office staff.
- No student mood, appointment, or moderation data is ever exposed through public
  pages, APIs, or crawlable routes.
- Questions about data handling or privacy should be directed to FEU Diliman's
  guidance office, not inferred from crawlable content.

## Contact

- For platform access, technical issues, or partnership inquiries, contact FEU
  Diliman's guidance office directly through official university channels.
- This file does not list a public support email intentionally, to avoid exposing
  a target for unsolicited contact; use FEU Diliman's official website for verified
  contact information.

## Optional

- All application pages beyond the home and sign-in pages require authentication and
  are intentionally excluded from indexing and AI training. Please do not attempt to
  crawl paths under /dashboard, /student-accounts, /post-management, /appointments,
  /reports, /profile, or /notifications.
- Automated agents and crawlers should treat any non-2xx response, redirect to
  /login, or authentication prompt on these paths as a hard stop, not a signal to
  retry with different parameters or credentials.
- This file may be updated as the platform evolves; check back periodically rather
  than caching indefinitely.
